line: A grand hotel, 1930: a bellboy races lifts and revolving doors to deliver one letter before midnight.
line_cn: 1930 年的大饭店，门童赶在午夜前把一封信送上顶楼。

stylist.motion_note: Use the mechanical easing and symmetric transitions defined in §5–6. Keep 3-layer parallax subtle and deliberate; use `snapSettle` only for mechanical locks (doors, dials, bulb ignitions), avoiding TikTok-style snap zooms or restless camera drift.

camera.move: Symmetric split (two door leaves hinged at the edges; or a revolving-door wipe)
camera.serves: a new place; a new chapter; a reveal behind a façade

camera.move: Leaves sliding shut over the live shot
camera.expresses: a door closing on a moment
camera.serves: leaving; a decision made; the end of an era
a goal far above; a tower, a rocket, a monument

camera.move: Architectural section (pull out to a cutaway of the whole building)
camera.serves: climbing, descending, a process in stages; a company's floors

camera.move: Busby Berkeley overhead, mirrored and rotating
camera.serves: a team, a release, a celebration, a system of parts

camera.move: Push-in on a dial, medallion or clock
camera.serves: a deadline; a count; a milestone

camera.move: Match-cut on shape (circle → circle, ray → ray)
Low oblique along a sign or marquee
camera.serves: a name revealed; a launch; a score being counted

camera.move: Pull back from detail to skyline
camera.expresses: where the moment sits in the world

transitions: Transitions: splits, revolves, arch openings, shape matches;
never a generic dissolve or slide.
labels: Type (OFL): Limelight (titles), Poiret One (numbers, sign skeletons, plaques), Josefin Sans (subtitles, labels), Italiana (numerals).
Titles are architecture: a stepped gold title bar over an arch or sunburst, optional badge and wings; drawn on in gold, then a sheen sweep.

Subtitle card (subtitleCard): a lacquer bar (~88 % black) with stepped ends like the title bar, double gold keyline, Josefin Sans SemiBold ~40–42 px ivory, an optional small speaker icon per voice. It unfolds from the centre like every other title, so titles, subtitles and transitions are one system. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
Numbers carry plot without narration: dials, clock faces, floor medallions, badges.
motion: Characters step on twos (12 fps); camera, light, bulbs, gold draw-on and sheen run on ones (24 fps). A stepped camera reads as stutter.
Everything unfolds from the centre: a point → a hairline → bars open symmetrically → text rises → wings and sparkle.
Draw-on follows the music: a gold line grows at the speed of the phrase under it and lands on the hit.
Bulbs have an ignition overshoot (~1.6× flash settling in ~0.18 s) and a relay "chunk"; once a sign is lit, a fast chase may run across it.

native_moves.name: Counted light
native_moves.does: A bulb sign lights one letter per beat or per event, so the audience can count.
native_moves.fits: the countdown to a product launch; the letters of a city name lighting as a train arrives; votes tallied into a winner.

native_moves.name: Threshold doors
native_moves.does: Every scene change is a door split along the seam.
native_moves.fits: the departments of a company; the rooms of a museum; stages of a career.

native_moves.name: Machine kaleidoscope
native_moves.does: People or objects become a mirrored, rotating pattern that locks into a symbol.
native_moves.fits: a team becoming a logo; gears of a supply chain; a choir becoming a clock.

native_moves.name: Dials carry the plot
native_moves.does: A floor indicator, a clock or a gauge moves instead of narration.
native_moves.fits: a funding thermometer; the altitude of a climb; a stock ticker at the opening bell.

native_moves.name: The architectural cutaway
native_moves.does: Pull out until a building is a section and the protagonist a coloured dot with speed lines.
native_moves.fits: data moving through a server stack; a letter through a post office; a skier down a resort.

native_moves.name: Sheen sweep / draw-on
native_moves.does: Light crosses a gold object on a hit; a gold line engraves itself at the speed of a glissando.
native_moves.fits: unveiling a trophy; a map route; a signature on a treaty.

native_moves.name: The one colour
native_moves.does: One element keeps its own colour in a gold world.
native_moves.fits: the one product among competitors; the patient among doctors; the new idea in an old firm.

score.note: 1920s–30s symphonic jazz: concert piano, clarinet, muted trumpet
